title: Crashpad: SSE truncation healing, customer escalation, and permanent correctness guard
creator: Maya Patel
description: Multiple customers reported deterministic parser failures when consuming hosted SSE streams: final JSON objects arrive truncated or never terminate, causing downstream crashes. This ticket tracks investigation, short-term mitigations, and a permanent fix to guarantee 'finality markers' for all streaming responses across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments.
reproduction_steps: 1) Create a long-running hosted generation (>4k tokens) using model redwood-70b-latest via streaming SSE endpoint
2) Simulate abrupt connection termination at edge (SIGTERM on proxy) while tokens are mid-flush
3) Observe client receives last chunk without final closing token (missing 'delta' with final=true / missing EOF sentinel), leaving JSON unclosed
4) Confirm downstream parser error when attempting to parse the incomplete final payload
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 10:12 - Pager alert from Tier 2: customer-b (healthcare analytics) reported repeated JSONDecodeError during production traffic spike
Initial triage showed spike in sse_truncation_total in us-west-2 and elevated 5xxs on edge-proxy around the same timestamp
Edge proxy logs show graceful-close sequence but internal flush buffer occasionally not written to wire when upstream serving process restarts
Runtime trace captured in sandbox: in-flight KV cache flush triggers small blocking syscall; if upstream worker dies during that sys-call, final sentinel event is not enqueued to event-streamer
Race between worker shutdown path and stream finalizer identified as root cause in hosted mode; dedicated/private sometimes masked by longer client timeouts
Found additional correctness gap: client-visible duplicate prefix can occur when session ID recycled quickly on reconnects; dedup logic assumed explicit final marker which was missing
mitigations_and_workarounds: Customer-facing workaround: recommend clients enable tolerant parsing (streaming-aware parser) and a 2s tail-wait before final JSON parse

Temporary server-side mitigation deployed (hotfix): edge proxy will emit a proactive 'final-sentinel' event on upstream disconnect if worker didn't produce it (feature-flagged: sse-proactive-sentinel=true). Deployed to canary region 03/11
RBAC note: mitigation only targets hosted control-plane; customers on Dedicated/Private asked to upgrade runtime to next patch to benefit from same guard
Support message templates sent to affected customers with explanation and short-term remediation steps
proposed_permanent_fix: 1) Ensure streaming runtime always commits a deterministic final-event into durable stream buffer before reporting success to client; make final-sentinel production-mandatory
2) Harden worker shutdown path: use two-phase drain where finalizer flush is awaited (with bounded timeout) and only then worker exits
3) Add idempotent final-event sealing at edge: edge will accept only one final-sentinel per session and garbage-collect stale session ids after TTL
4) Improve client SDKs with clear stream contract and an optional auto-repair: SDK will attempt to fetch final snapshot via /responses/{session}/finalize when sentinel missing
implementation_plan: A) Runtime change (PR #2203): add final-sentinel write and bounded drain; unit tests and e2e that inject SIGTERM
B) Edge change (PR #1297): proactive sentinel on disconnect & session TTL enforcement
C) SDK patch (PR #443): streaming parser tolerant mode + finalize endpoint call
D) Rollout: canary us-west-2 for 48h -> additional regions staggered 12h apart, full global after 96h if stable
E) Toggle feature flag for quick rollback (sse-proactive-sentinel), prepare rollback play if error rates spike

https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1297 - edge: emit sentinel on abrupt connection close
Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/5467/SSE+Finality+Design - design notes and sequence diagrams
Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/streaming/hosted-sse-truncation (alert panels and runbook links)
testing_and_validation: Automated: introduce chaos test that sends SIGKILL during in-flight token emission and assert final-sentinel persisted
E2E: multi-region playback of previously failing customer trace and verify parser succeeds
Performance: ensure drain semantics don't add >1% p99 tail latency for steady-state short responses
Canary monitoring: alert if sse_truncation_total increases by >25% relative to baseline or 5xx rises
rollout_and_monitoring: Stage 1 (Canary - us-west-2): enable sse-proactive-sentinel in canary for 48h, run verification suite; on success progress to Stage 2
Stage 2 (Regional ramp): enable in eu-west-1 and us-east-1, observe for 48h
Stage 3 (Global): enable everywhere, adopt runtime-2.3.1 as minimum for Dedicated/Private upgrade notes
SLO impact: temporarily suppress noisy alerts for affected customers while rollback risk is validated; update on-call runbook
acceptance_criteria: All affected customers confirm no further truncation incidents for a 72h window post-global rollout
Automated tests added to CI that reproduce the SIGTERM truncation and verify final sentinel behavior
No regression in p50/p95/p99 latency >2% in canary region attributable to the fix
SDK patch released and client-facing docs updated with finalize endpoint guidance
postmortem_summary: Root cause: a race in the worker shutdown path allowed a worker to exit before emitting the final streaming sentinel, combined with edge proxy not generating defensive final events. This resulted in incomplete final payloads that caused client parser crashes. Corrective actions: forced final-sentinel on drain, edge-level defensive sentinel, SDK tolerant parsing + finalize call, and improved chaos tests. Follow-ups: upgrade path for Dedicated/Private customers and a policy to include finality tests in model onboarding.
